assessments.reasoning: Eight contiguous captures cover the 130,871-byte SPDX json/details record at the claimed commit. Part 1 gives isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Part 5 gives licenseId=GPL-3.0-only, the name “GNU General Public License v3.0 only”, the comments and standard header. Its seeAlso fields cite GNU’s gpl-3.0-standalone.html and OSI’s /license/GPL-3.0-only. These are references, not independently inspected witnesses.

The SPDX repository’s GitHub API tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0 and targets commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, the revision in the JSON locator and claim. The tag is unsigned. Its evidentiary role is the release-to-commit link.

The digest-matched GNU text supplies edition and version-choice context. Section 14 makes the later-version option conditional on what the program specifies. The appendix’s sample takes that option. Evidence for the only identifier and its matching header comes from SPDX.

challenge.method: I tested whether matching the full GPL text or its sample notice could select GPL-3.0-only. I compared licenseText, standardLicenseTemplate, standardLicenseHeader and licenseComments in both generated records.
challenge.results: Even the GPL-3.0-only record reproduces the later-version example in licenseText. SPDX marks the application appendix optional for matching and supplies a distinct version-3-only standard header. The apparent wording conflict is resolved by identifying which notice actually applies to the file. A recipient choosing to follow version 3 under an or-later grant still received an or-later grant.

limitations: The FSF appendix illustrates the later-version election. The version-3-only header comes from SPDX’s matching guidance. An actual file’s applicable notice must supply the grant.

Both correspondence records use the same subject, edition and publisher digest, leave conditions empty, and encode the distinguishing election in the statement and SPDX key. Reading the mappings without the statements would lose a material qualification. SCES §3 requires that qualification to survive downstream use.
reasoning: SPDX License List 3.29.0 lists GPL-3.0-only. Its standard header ends the version selection with “version 3.” Its comments say that the applicable notice identifies the choice for the code in the file. The proposal’s “version 3 alone” accurately describes that election. “Granting use” is a paraphrase of a notice that expressly addresses redistribution and modification.
